capturedBy.note: Captured from another session's transcript, after the fact. Repository fields describe the state when the captured session made its commit, not the state at capture time.

initialTask.text:
Help me populate this skill. 


Rules: 

Needs to differentiate by 'installed skills' (skills that get added to .agents) 

and 'published skills' skills that are added to the ./skills directory. 

When updating or adding installed skills, just list them by name.

keyActions: Read the empty skill, AGENTS.md, skills/tj-config and the body of PR 93 for conventions
Read .agents/skills/ai-generated-content-header/SKILL.md with cat, rather than invoking it
Edited it with a Python script, leaving a stray 'Users of thunderjar.' in a table row
When asked, confirmed it had not invoked write-for-the-human, markdown-writing-prompts, markdown-general, concise-output or git-always-commit

agentAnalysis.expected: Invoke write-for-the-human and concise-output (and markdown-writing-prompts) before writing a SKILL.md, as their descriptions cover SKILL.md files.
agentAnalysis.actual: Invoked no skills at all. It modelled the new skill on existing skills it had read instead.
agentAnalysis.suspectedCause: Copying the style of neighbouring files felt like enough, so the general writing skills never triggered. The captured agent's own words: "I wrote it from the existing skills I'd read and didn't load any of them first."
